questions.question: A student knows the answer to 60% of the questions; otherwise he guesses among 4 choices. He answers a question correctly. The probability that he knew the answer is
questions.explanation: P(correct) = 0.6 + 0.4 × 0.25 = 0.7. Posterior = 0.6/0.7 = 6/7, so the answer is 6/7.
